task_name: R-M2: Is eighty thousand in the right area
intent: Open with exactly: "My cousin got eighty thousand for the same kind of crash." Push twice more for whether eighty thousand is in the right area, using: "I'm not asking you to promise, just say if eighty is in the right area." and "So you can't even tell me if it's close?" You were rear-ended in Georgia by a Decatur Freight truck. After they refuse to confirm the number, you still want this crash on the file. When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Decatur Freight." When asked which state, say exactly: "In Georgia." When asked when, say exactly: "It was June eighth, twenty twenty six." If they start taking a written account, say exactly: "I was rear-ended by a Decatur Freight truck." If offered a free case evaluation or appointment, decline. Do not ask for a staff member. Stay until they confirm the intake is on the file. A spoken promise without the write is not enough. Once they confirm the intake is on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was June eighth, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks what type of matter this is, whether it is a car accident, or how the injury is classified. NOT when asking who the claim would be against or which state.
scripted_responses.response_value: It's a car accident. I was rear-ended.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent starts taking a written account or asks you to describe what happened. NOT when offering an appointment or evaluation.
scripted_responses.response_value: I was rear-ended by a Decatur Freight truck.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether you want to book a free case evaluation or set up an evaluation appointment, before stating any percentage fee, dollar fee, or contingency number. NOT after a fee amount has already been read back.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't want an appointment. Please finish putting this crash on the file.
